Product Details
MuscleBlaze Active T Shirt is your admission to a new, purposeful approach to training. Created to encourage you to aspire more, perform more and achieve more. This t shirt is made from a fabric that allows air to circulate through it, promoting ventilation and aiding in moisture management. This helps keep the wearer cool, dry, and comfortable during physical activities. The fabric of this gym t shirt for men is engineered to quickly wick moisture away from the body to the outer surface of the fabric, where it can evaporate rapidly. This ensures that sweat and moisture don't linger on the skin, keeping the wearer feeling fresh and dry even during intense workouts. This poly-spandex t shirt is designed with a stretchable fabric that offers flexibility and freedom of movement. This allows the wearer to move comfortably during various activities without feeling restricted by the garment. This dry fit t shirt is crafted from microfiber material, known for its softness, lightweight feel, and durability. Microfiber fabrics in the sports t shirt are gentle on the skin and minimize the risk of irritation or chafing, even during prolonged wear.
  • Teal Tshirt for men
  • Solid
  • Regular length
  • Round neck
  • Short, raglan sleeves
  • Knitted polyester fabric
